metadata.article_title: Procedure of Authority, Appellate Authority and National Appellate Authority.

article.title: Procedure of Authority, Appellate Authority and National Appellate Authority.
article.content: The Authority or the Appellate Authority 3[or the National Appellate Authority] shall, subject to the provisions of this Chapter, have power to regulate its own procedure.
article.html:
1062[Procedure of Authority, Appellate Authority and National Appellate Authority.]

Section 106 · Chapter XVII · page 85 of the Act

The Authority or the Appellate Authority 3[or the National Appellate Authority] shall, subject to the provisions of this Chapter, have power to regulate its own procedure.

2 Subs. by Act 23 of 2019, s. 110, for “marginal heading” (w.e.f. 1-1-2020).

3 Ins. by Act 23 of 2019, s. 110 (w.e.f. 1-1-2020).
